frequency_question: How often do states with high intent and baseline technical capability successfully establish domestic production of complex imported precision guided munitions within the specified window?
membership_rule: Includes sovereign states attempting to domesticate licensed production of sophisticated foreign cruise missiles or equivalent precision strike systems under wartime or acute crisis urgency. Excludes low-tech munitions like mortar shells or basic UAVs.

cases.name: Ukraine domestic localization of Western artillery/air defense components (Spur 1)
Ukraine domestic production of anti-ship missiles (Neptune rapid scaling)
Ukraine domestic production attempts for complex imported Western guided glide bombs/missiles

coverage_note: 3 named cases representing the relevant class of wartime advanced weapon localization efforts by the state.
known_gaps: Extremely sparse historical precedent for transferring Storm Shadow/SCALP level tech lines into active combat zones within short timeframes.
skeleton: class of high-tech defense localization initiatives under urgent state priority: 3 major initiatives attempted, 2 achieved component/assembly capability, 1 achieved full complex system line within window
multiplier: 2 hits out of 3 major comparable cases
validity_reason: Wartime urgency and industrial base conditions remain relatively stable descriptors for the next two years.
